Rocky Mountain Area(PL 4)   
Fire Activity and Teams Assigned Totals 
New fires: 5

CIMTs Committed: 6 
 
Aspen Acres, Custer County. CIMT (NR Team 6). Twenty miles southwest of Pueblo, CO. Timber. Moderate 
fire behavior with flanking and single tree torching. Numerous residences threatened. Evacuations, area, road 
and trail closures in effect. 
 
Gold Mountain, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. CIMT (RM Team 2). CIMT (RM Team 
1) mobilizing. Two miles north of Ouray, CO. Grass, brush and timber. Minimal fire behavior with flanking, 
backing and creeping. Numerous structures and critical infrastructure threatened. Evacuations, area, road and 
trail closures in effect. Precipitation occurred over the fire area yesterday. 
 
Elk, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. CIMT (NW Team 8). Seven miles northwest of 
Lake City, CO. Timber, heavy slash and grass. Minimal fire behavior with creeping and smoldering. 
Residences threatened. Evacuations, area, road and trail closures in effect. Precipitation occurred over the fire 
area yesterday. 
 
Willow, Pike and San Isabel NF, USFS. CIMT (CA Team 8). Six miles west of Leadville, CO. Brush, closed 
timber litter and timber. Moderate fire behavior with creeping, isolated torching and smoldering. Residences 
and critical infrastructure threatened. Evacuations, area, road and trail closures in effect. Precipitation occurred 
over the fire area yesterday. 
 
Fishhook, Medicine Bow-Routt NF, USFS. Transfer of command from CIMT (SW Team 1) back to the local 
unit will occur tomorrow. Eight miles southeast of Steamboat Springs, CO. Grass, brush and timber. Minimal 
fire behavior with smoldering. Area, road and trail closures in effect. Precipitation occurred over the fire area 
yesterday. 
 
Ferris, San Juan NF, USFS. Seven miles east of Cahone, CO. Timber and brush. Minimal fire behavior with 
smoldering. Area, road and trail closures in effect. 
 
Keystone, White River Field Office, BLM. Forty-five miles northwest of Meeker, CO. Brush, timber and 
dormant brush. Moderate fire behavior with running, flanking and creeping. Residences threatened. 
 
Fuhr Gulch, Moffat County. Three miles southwest of Craig, CO. Brush and grass. Minimal fire behavior with 
smoldering.
